item.title: The Autumn Sale 2026 is here!
item.description:
Autumn Sale has begun!

Lord Captain, the time has come to claim your legacy!

Receive your Warrant of Trade and embark on your mighty space vessel. Travel across the void on your quest for glory, influence and wealth as you seek to uncover the secrets of the von Valancius dynasty. Set your foot on dangerous alien planets, encounter exotic creatures and determine the fate of entire worlds.

Your options include:

1. Begin your adventure aboard your personal giant voidship, traveling between the multitude of systems within the Koronus Expanse, a barely charted and incredibly perilous region of space. Despite being considered a backwater of the Imperium, this region encompasses an enormous stretch of the void, filled with dangerous creatures and prodigious opportunities for profit and exploration:


2. Gain access to two major expansions for Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - Void Shadows and Lex Imperialis, and expand your campaign with two new companions, exciting new storylines and new interesting mechanics, receiving over 30 hours of content at an additional discount:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2687230/Warhammer_40000_Rogue_Trader__Season_Pass/

3. The story does not end with the first two DLCs! Get Season Pass 2 to instantly gain access to DLC III — The Infinite Museion, where you will join forces with eccentric Tech-Priest Eogunn Februs and delve into a secret vault curated by Trazyn the Infinite himself, as well as future access to the upcoming DLC IV — Processional of the Damned. There, along with your new companion — Miraculist Stella — you will venture into the Processional — a massive, otherworldly graveyard of ships lost to the void:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3650060/Warhammer_40000_Rogue_Trader__Season_Pass_2/

4. Get the base game, Season Pass 1, Digital Artbook, Digital OST, Wallpaper Pack and a selection of in-game items in a single big package:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36542/Warhammer_40000_Rogue_Trader__Voidfarer_Edition/
These are just some examples of the available content for the game - check out its page to find out about more options!

Your crew awaits you, Lord Captain!

item.title: Return Of The Waaagh
item.description:
OI GITS!

Hope you've had a good summer, we have been a little quiet since the last big update where we've been looking at your bugs, requests and how people have responded and reacted to crossplay.

Now our focus is on building a propa 'Kult of Speed' from you all - both in giving existing players reasons to come back and play whilst we simultaneously widen our marketing and try different things to get more people into the speedwaaagh!


Buildin' Da Kult

As mentioned, we've been looking into how to make it easier for you all to get games organised and get a good scrap, whilst bigger turns and ideas take time to get runnin' there's some early doors things we want to get spinning that won't take the long setup, such as :

Region Discord Roles :

We've seen requests for folks to voluntarily be able to tag themselves in specific regions / timezones so groups can mob up with a simple discord tag and get folks who have the krumping itch there and then (Looking at you OCE gits!) . This is something that we can setup and get rolling sharpish.




'Mob on Me' Nights :

Something that the team used to do fairly regularly that we wanna bring back - starting this Monday (time still being hashed out so keep an eye for Discord and social confirmation), whilst the bois are knee deep in all their dev bits across projects, we'll look at bringing in the hardcore evangelists, our own internal producers and leads, and simply fun creators that will be able to show the game off to wider audiences to all jump on at pre-communicated times and ensure you've got a range of experiences to play against.

Quick note though obviously there's WIDE range of timezones for folks, we'll be keeping it EU/US friendly to begin with as thats where we work and sleep around - but expand out if some superstars wanna take the charge in other regions!




Mek Workshop Competitions : The creation tool is POWERFUL, and we want to celebrate what you make in it - give you incentives to jump on with your gits and mess around - and to spotlight and promote it wider.

We're going to start regular competitions where we challenge the community to create something based on a specific keyword, or theme. Then we'll dive in ourselves and play through what gets made, pick the ones that really shine (or are too silly not to spotlight).

Two of 'em will get chosen as winners and given prizes in the form of models, kits, other merch and immortality in the form of being shown to the world - as well as posted on the games main menu roulette wheel where we'll host them as part of our Mob on Me nights to bring the wider community into your creations.

We'll be showing you some tips and tricks videos too, as well as working with some of the most creative gits out there to take you through some build videos, and Q and A's on how to really get the most out the toolkit.

But for now, you get a headstart - go start building something based around the concept of 'AntiGravity' (it can mean WHATEVER your interpretation of that is - just full send to impress us)


Longer Tail

This is just the start of getting the Kult back up to speed for us, and whilst we won't quite go into full detail on the longer term ideas (some of which by necessity as they need greenlighting and sign off's from the powers that be above) - we promise we are seeing all your feedback, and are dedicated to getting as much dakka as possible from as many of you as possible. So sit tight, and keep telling us what you think!


Of course as much as we can market, there's nothing that QUITE sells a game to others quite like seeing other people playing and enjoying the game - so carry on playin', scrappin', creatin', krumpin' and telling all yer mates about it!

Which - coincidentally - the game is now on sale for like, a heretically low price, so spread the word (and tell the console gits about it with the crossplay too yeah)

JOIN DA DISCORD 💬

Again we've got a Speed Freeks Discord running, so be sure to jump in there to chat with and mob up to race n' krump https://discord.gg/Phh5FK3Sdf
